verdict.rationale: The personalization docs describe personal instructions that, in Codex, are stored in a global AGENTS.md file, which Codex reads before doing any work. Persistent Memories carry context from earlier chats into future work, with /memories controls, and projects supply standing context. Together these deliver persistent instructions that shape responses, though the ChatGPT-chat side is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the custom-instructions UI and fields in ChatGPT chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration that instructions reliably apply to every response.
